title: Zero-Downtime Database Migration Plan
description: A structured plan for a live-database schema change -- engine, change type, deploy phasing, lock/backfill/tool decisions -- so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/zero_downtime_database_migration_audit.mjs.

changeType.description: The shape of the schema change.

deployPhases.description: How many separate deploys the change is split across. Breaking changes require >= 3 (expand -> migrate -> contract).

lockTimeoutSeconds.description: The lock_timeout set on the migration session, in seconds. Commonly < 2; 0/absent means wait forever.

indexCreatedConcurrently.description: True if index builds use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY (Postgres).

fkUsesNotValidThenValidate.description: True if FK adds are split into ADD CONSTRAINT ... NOT VALID then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT (Postgres).

backfillRequired.description: True if historical rows must be backfilled as part of this change.

backfillBatchSize.description: Rows per backfill batch. 0/absent with backfillRequired means a single-statement backfill (rejected). 1k-10k recommended.

backfillUsesSkipLocked.description: True if batch selection uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.

backfillSleepBetweenBatches.description: True if the backfill sleeps between batches to protect replication and autovacuum.

replicaLagMonitored.description: True if replica lag is watched during the backfill with a pause criterion.

dualWritesPlanned.description: True if the app will write to both old and new schema during the migration.

dualWriteFeatureFlagged.description: True if the dual-write is gated by a feature flag toggleable without redeploy.

verificationBeforeContract.description: True if counts + sampled diffs + error-rate checks run before the irreversible contract step.

rollbackPlanDocumented.description: True if a per-phase rollback plan is documented before deploy.

rehearsedOnSnapshot.description: True if the migration was rehearsed and timed on a production snapshot.

tableHasForeignKeys.description: True if the target table participates in foreign keys (gh-ost does not support them).

binlogFormatRow.description: True if MySQL binary logging is ROW-based (required by gh-ost).

tableRowCount.description: Approximate row count of the target table.
